articles.summary: Adtran today announced that Telia Estonia, part of Nordic and Baltic telecommunications operator Telia Company, is trialing its 50G PON technology as the next step in the evolution of its fiber broadband infrastructure.
articles.title: Telia Estonia trials Adtran 50G PON technology to prepare for next-generation broadband services

articles.summary: AI can take fiber operations beyond passive monitoring, helping teams correlate network data, diagnose problems and automate defined tasks safely. Here’s how better context, open data and spec-driven workflows can turn network telemetry into practical action.
articles.title: Transforming network operations with AI: A practical guide
